title: Crypto-Cash Back: Frequently Asked Questions About Crypto Rewards
summary: This document explains Crypto-Cash Back rewards: you earn 2.0% on eligible spend, can redeem for crypto starting at $30, and may choose up to 12 cryptocurrencies. It lists a 1.25% conversion fee, a $75 annual fee, APR on carried balances of 19.49%, and a 1.5% minimum monthly payment, plus 0% foreign transaction fees and no purchase protection.
